items.problem: Bootstrap omitted UWP project items linked from sibling shared-content directories, producing an incomplete mapping and cascading manual-reconstruction errors.
items.evidence: session-log.txt turn 2 copied 7 files and mapped no linked XAML; the preserved PenHaptics.csproj lines 130-190 declares linked MainPage, Styles, five scenario pages, and assets; turns 4-32 show manual recreation and repeated build errors.
items.skill_search: Searched Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 for Link, Compile Include, Page Include, Content Include, and SharedContent; only recursive Get-ChildItem under -Source existed.
items.root_cause: The bootstrap treated the project directory tree as the complete project instead of honoring explicit MSBuild Include+Link inputs.
items.proposed_fix: Parse explicit source-bearing csproj items, copy external inputs to their Link paths, and include those target paths in namespace rewrite, triage, mapping, and deferred artifacts.
items.generalizes: UWP SDK samples and multi-project apps commonly link shared XAML, helpers, resources, and media from sibling directories.

items.problem: A missing merged ResourceDictionary target survived build and produced an opaque startup crash that made all five scored features unavailable.
items.evidence: migration-score.json reports candidate launch failed and 5/5 features failed; session-log.txt turns 41-47 show repeated 0xc000027b Microsoft.UI.Xaml.dll crashes; generated App.xaml references /Styles/Styles.xaml while the generated file was at root Styles.xaml.
items.skill_search: Searched SKILL.md, MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md, and validator for ResourceDictionary, MergedDictionaries, Source URI, and resource URI; only theme resource-key guidance existed.
items.root_cause: No deterministic validation connected local ResourceDictionary Source URIs to packaged target files; the 0xc000027b guidance over-focused on legacy API activation.
items.proposed_fix: Add a validator gate that resolves local and ms-appx ResourceDictionary Source URIs and reports missing target files before build/launch diagnosis.
items.generalizes: Shared UWP resource dictionaries are frequently linked or moved during migration, and URI/path mismatches commonly build successfully but fail during XAML initialization.

items.problem: Test-AppLaunch.ps1 could not discover a valid default dotnet build output.
items.evidence: session-log.txt turn 32 built successfully to bin\Debug; turn 33 immediately returned status=unavailable because it only searched bin\x64\Debug.
items.skill_search: Inspected Test-AppLaunch.ps1 layout discovery and found only bin/<arch>/Debug and bin/<rid>/Debug candidates.
items.wrong_text_if_any: No build output found under bin\x64\Debug - build the project first.
items.root_cause: The helper assumed winapp/Platform-segmented output even though the skill also permits native dotnet build.
items.proposed_fix: Search both architecture-segmented and default bin/Debug trees for the newest directory containing an executable and AppxManifest.
items.generalizes: Any migration using ordinary dotnet build before the smoke launch can emit the default non-Platform-segmented layout.
